evals.prompt: visualize how a scheduled email digest gets sent in this app. start from the cron/scheduler entry and go all the way to the mail provider. i want to step through it file by file with the code
evals.expected_output: A step-through page tracing the schedule line, the command, the selection query, the fan-out job, the per-recipient job and the mail transport, each step quoting real code with file, method, line, highlighted lines, a note and load pills; the chat reply lists phases, step count and anything surprising found.
expectations: trace.html exists, is a self-contained page whose inline scripts parse (node --check) and loads scripts only from allowed CDNs
The page has Back and Forward controls plus ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard navigation to move through steps
At least 10 distinct real repo files are referenced and every referenced file path exists on disk
Code snippets are verbatim: at least 80% of sampled non-trivial code lines (30+ chars) are found verbatim in the repo
The trace has between 15 and 45 steps
Every step names the executing method and highlights the executing lines within the snippet
Steps that run inside a loop (per recipient, per row) are labelled as repeating and state the per-iteration cost
The chat reply reports at least one concrete cost or risk finding tied to a specific file (sync external call, N+1, missing guard, queue setting, timeout)
No em-dash character appears in trace.html or the chat reply
Covers the whole chain from the scheduler entry through the queued jobs to the external mail call
